description: This file defines the AboutOrganization class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used in the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates details about an organization such as company name, version, and employee counts, including getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: AboutOrganization
classes.description: A DTO class that stores organization-related data such as company name, version, number of active employees, and past employees.

methods.name: getNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of active employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfActiveEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of active employees.

methods.name: getNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Returns the number of past employees.

methods.name: setNumberOfPastEmployee
methods.description: Sets the number of past employees.
